theme: End-of-tomato-season Italian — one jar of confit and one pot of beans carry the whole week (2 adults; girls with Jen).

components.name: Slow-roasted tomato confit
components.ingredients: 2 lb ripe cherry/Campari or plum tomatoes, 1 cup good olive oil, 6 smashed garlic cloves, thyme + oregano sprigs, flaky salt, pinch chili
components.method: Halve the tomatoes and nestle them cut-side up in a baking dish with the garlic and herbs. Pour in olive oil to come halfway up, season with flaky salt and a pinch of chili. Roast at 300°F for 60–75 min until collapsed and jammy. Cool and store submerged in the oil in a jar (fridge, up to 2 weeks). Save every drop of that oil — it's your searing and dressing gold all week.

components.name: Brothy cannellini beans
components.time: ~75 min hands-off (plus overnight or quick soak)
components.ingredients: 1 lb dried cannellini (or 3 cans, drained), 1 onion halved, 1 carrot, 1 celery rib, 1 garlic head halved, bay, sage, parmesan rind, 1/4 cup olive oil, salt
components.method: Combine soaked beans with the aromatics, parm rind, and olive oil; cover with water by 2 inches. Bring to a bare simmer and cook gently until creamy but still intact, about 60–90 min, salting only in the last 15 min. Pull the aromatics and keep the beans in their brodo — that liquid is the base for half the dinners below.

dinners.name: Spoon-basted cod over brothy beans with salsa verde
dinners.ingredients: 2 cod (or hake/halibut) fillets, cannellini + brodo, tomato confit, parsley, capers, lemon, garlic, butter
steps: Warm a ladleful of beans with their brodo and a few confit tomatoes; keep it loose and brothy.
Pat cod very dry and season. Sear presentation-side down in confit oil until deep golden.
Add a knob of butter, garlic and thyme; tilt the pan and spoon-baste the top until just opaque.
Spoon beans into shallow bowls, set the cod on top, finish with salsa verde and a squeeze of lemon.

dinners.name: Orecchiette with tomato confit, cannellini & broccoli rabe
dinners.ingredients: orecchiette, broccoli rabe (or broccolini), tomato confit + its oil, cannellini, garlic, chili flakes, pecorino
steps: Boil the orecchiette; blanch the rabe in the same water, drain and roughly chop.
Sizzle garlic and chili in confit oil; add the rabe, a scoop of beans, and confit tomatoes, crushing them lightly.
Toss with the pasta and a splash of pasta water to emulsify.
Finish with pecorino and a thread of olive oil.

dinners.name: Mussels in white-bean & tomato brodo with grilled bread
dinners.ingredients: 2 lb mussels, cannellini brodo, tomato confit, white wine, shallot, garlic, parsley, crusty bread
steps: Sweat shallot and garlic in confit oil; add white wine and reduce by half.
Add a ladle of beans with their brodo plus a few confit tomatoes; simmer to a light brodo.
Add mussels, cover, and steam until they open, 4–5 min; discard any that stay shut.
Finish with parsley and olive oil; serve with garlic-rubbed grilled bread.

dinners.name: Tomato-confit & white bean gratin with fried egg + arugula
dinners.ingredients: cannellini, tomato confit, breadcrumbs, parmesan, eggs, arugula, lemon
steps: Fold beans with confit tomatoes into a baking dish; top with parmesan breadcrumbs and a drizzle of confit oil.
Fry the eggs in confit oil and set them over the gratin.
Pile on arugula dressed with lemon and confit oil.

technique.name: Arroser (spoon-basting)
technique.tiedTo: The seared cod — once the crust sets, add butter, garlic and thyme, tilt the pan, and spoon the foaming fat over the top. It cooks the fish gently and evenly from above while the bottom stays crisp. The skill is reading the foam: keep it foaming and nutty, never browning to burnt.

shopping.items: 2 lb ripe cherry/Campari or plum tomatoes, broccoli rabe or broccolini, arugula, lemons, flat-leaf parsley, 2 heads garlic (plus extra), onion, carrot, celery, shallot, fresh thyme, sage, oregano
butter, eggs, parmesan (plus a rind if you can), pecorino
1 lb dried cannellini (or 3 cans), orecchiette, plenty of good olive oil, capers, dried chili flakes, bay leaves, white wine, breadcrumbs, flaky salt, crusty bread

scaleNote: This week is 2 adults — girls are with Jen. To feed the full house of 6 on a girls week: double both components. Serve the cod flaked into the beans rather than plated whole and go easy on the chili. Make the orecchiette the centerpiece (about 1.5 lb pasta, rabe chopped fine). For the kids, skip mussels or serve just the tomato-bean brodo as a dunking soup with lots of bread. The gratin scales best — make it 1.5x with a couple of extra eggs.
